verdict.rationale: Vapi's HIPAA/compliance docs say users can "control how call recordings and logs are stored," and an organization-wide compliance mode can be turned on in the Dashboard. This is a first-party control over data storage. The evidence does not show configurable retention periods or explicit deletion of call data, so depth is unproven. Missing for 10: documented retention-period settings, explicit deletion APIs or controls for calls, recordings and transcripts, granular per-assistant retention, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
